message:
docs: prune lapsed gold sponsors and rebalance logo sizing

Remove Brand.dev, Courier, Liblab, and Retool from the Gold tier
based on a sponsor audit (no recent payment in GitHub Sponsors or
either Stripe account). Update Zernio's logo to the official primary
wordmark, and add a per-logo h-12 override so dense wordmarks
(Zernio, Stainless) read at the same visual weight as the others.
author: Colin McDonnell
